positions.as_written: Place tunnels anatomically, since position dominates every other variable.
Expect measured laxity to change over the first year without a new injury.
Treat the reconstruction as a construct in an environment rather than as an operation.
Measure slope in every revision, since it is the commonest unaddressed factor.
Plan single or two stage revision from tunnel imaging rather than from preference.
